claims.event: campaigns of the Qing founder Taizu against the Wula kingdom (outside-knowledge conversion: Nurhaci's career AD 1583-AD 1626; the Wula conquest is conventionally dated AD 1613)

claims.action: successively captured the Wula cities of Yihanshan, Linhe, Jinzhou and Xunzhata and pacified the Wula kingdom

claims.event: recalled as the founding ancestor of the Qing house who resided at Edoli city / Emohui

status.en: founding ancestor of the Qing imperial house

translationRepairs: Also to the northwest, from Wojiling Ridge out the northern foothills of Changbai, along the Gudong and Fuer rivers through Huadian and Panshi to Hailong in Fengtian — popularly called the Pandas Road, it was a major thoroughfare in the early Qing.

Also to the northwest, from Wojiling Ridge out the northern foothills of Changbai, along the Gudong and Fuer rivers through Huadian and Panshi to Hailong in Fengtian — popularly called Pandao (the Winding Road), it was a major thoroughfare in the early Qing.
盤道 is a road name meaning 'winding road' (Pandao); 'Pandas' is a mistransliteration. The literal field has the same error ('Pandas Road').
